subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, leaving channel-selective replies to existing host routing policy or a separate API follow-up?
rationale: The source-confirmed command prompt gap is narrow, but allowing prompts or rules to choose delivery channels would change channel/message delivery policy and may affect plugin contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle() only.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep this issue or a new linked item for a separate product/API design before changing reply delivery behavior.

options.title: Decline Prompt-Driven Routing
options.body: Document that reply routing remains host-controlled and close the broader selective-routing portion once the metadata gap is handled.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle() only.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest history on the shared command prompt bundle and already posted the most specific scope guidance on this issue.
